nodes.action: Read the project guidance, current client or importer, representative input data, and external contract before editing; identify existing side effects, return shapes, and audit hooks.
nodes.name: Inspect project scope
preconditions: Target project and stated entry points are available
nodes.validator: Required files are read and the expected input, output, and dispatch boundaries are documented.

nodes.action: Translate documented requirements into explicit local checks, including required/type/format/range/enum/normalization rules, cross-field or duplicate constraints, and an explicit timezone policy with UTC normalization where timestamps are accepted.
nodes.name: Derive local validation rules
nodes.validator: Every documented rejection condition has a deterministic local rule, timestamps have an explicit timezone policy, and expected representations are defined.

nodes.action: Define one stable structured error object containing the field or scope, machine-readable code, human-readable message, and relevant value or context; define a per-record failure entry that preserves the original index and payload.
nodes.name: Define structured diagnostics shape
nodes.validator: Each validation failure maps to a complete structured error with field or scope, code, message, and relevant context, while original index and payload are retained.

nodes.action: Specify and implement collection behavior so every applicable field and cross-field failure is recorded for a record before dispatch eligibility is decided, without short-circuiting on the first error.
nodes.name: Accumulate validation failures
nodes.validator: A record with several invalid fields yields a collection containing all applicable structured errors and remains associated with its original position.

nodes.action: Update the processor to validate and normalize each record before any outbound operation, route invalid records to failures, and invoke the external operation only for records with no errors.
nodes.name: Implement pre-dispatch gate
nodes.validator: For every record, validation precedes dispatch; records with errors produce no outbound call, while valid records retain input order.

nodes.action: Return the project’s required aggregate structure with complete successes, failures, trace or audit data when applicable, and totals derived from the original batch rather than hard-coded counts.
nodes.name: Preserve batch accounting
nodes.validator: Total equals succeeded plus failed, every input index appears exactly once, and failure details retain original values where required.

nodes.action: Exercise valid records, each individual invalid condition, combinations of simultaneous failures, optional fields, timezone and UTC-normalization boundaries when relevant, duplicates, and mixed batches.
nodes.name: Build boundary-focused checks
nodes.validator: Checks cover rejection semantics, complete multi-error collection, timezone normalization policy, and absence of outbound calls for rejected records.

nodes.action: Run the focused checks and inspect returned structures plus the mock or audit trace; compare observed calls, indices, errors, normalized values, and counts against the derived contract.
nodes.name: Run verification first
nodes.validator: All checks pass, invalid records have no dispatch trace, valid records are dispatched, and diagnostics are complete and contract-shaped.
